subject: Mutual action plan & dependency radar — proposed milestones and owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@praxishealth.com>, Matt Garcia <matt.garcia@praxishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & dependency radar — proposed milestones and owners

Emma / Matt,

Great speaking with you this morning. Per our call I put together a starter mutual action plan (attached) and a short "dependency radar" that highlights systems and approvals we need from Praxis before we can hit a July 28th go-live target. High-level ask: please confirm owners for the rows marked "Praxis owner" and any dates that are optimistic.

Key milestone highlights (from MAP_v1):
- Week 0 (kickoff): SLA/contacts, vault/KMS access, SSO metadata exchange — Praxis owner: (TBD) — target: 2027-06-06
- Week 2 (platform integration): API keys, inbound event schema, embedding contract test — Praxis owner: Data Eng (TBD) — target: 2027-06-20
- Week 4 (staging validation): E2E smoke tests, load profile, quality gate for 80/90 prompts — Praxis owner: Product Ops (TBD) — target: 2027-07-04
- Week 8 (go-live week): production cutover plan, rollback windows, support escalation rota — Praxis owner: Ops (TBD) — target: 2027-07-28

Attachments: Praxis_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with tasks, owners, acceptance criteria), implementation_dependencies_v1.pdf (third-party deps and gating items).

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the attached MAP and mark Praxis owners in column D by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-02).
2) We schedule a 30-min runbook sync with Marissa and Soojin to align testing windows and acceptance criteria (suggested slot: Thu 2027-06-03 10:00 PT).
3) Redwood will pre-stage a sandbox instance and share service-account creds once KMS/SCIM access is confirmed.

If that timeline looks broadly fine I'll publish a HubSpot plan and move the MAP to collaborative Drive.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: Praxis_MAP_v1.xlsx (30 KB), implementation_dependencies_v1.pdf (46 KB)

Ben,

Thanks — this looks helpful and very detailed. Quick notes from our side after an initial review:
- KMS/SSO: I can get our security lead (Matt) to own the KMS key exchange and SSO metadata. I'll confirm by Wednesday EOD.
- Data engineering owner: Alex Park will be primary; I'll loop him into the kickoff.
- The July 28th target is ambitious but feasible provided we keep the Week 2 integration window clear for the API contract work. If possible can we push the staging validation window one week earlier (target 2027-06-27) so we have a longer buffer for cutover dry runs?

Also, could you confirm what level of log retention and audit detail Redwood will expose for our compliance team? We have a quick questionnaire they will run.

Happy to take the 30-min runbook sync on 2027-06-03 — 10:00 PT works for me. Please send a calendar invite.

Best,
Emma Johnson
Head of Partnerships | Praxis Health

Ben / Soojin,

Appreciate the MAP — looked through dependencies doc. A few operational notes from CS/Implementation perspective:
- Acceptance gate: for staging validation we need a defined prompt set of 120 prompts across the 4 priority intents. I'll create that and drop into the Drive (playbook-sprint-roster.docx).
- Load testing: suggest we reserve a 4-hour window for sustained 50 RPS traffic on staging; Soojin, can your team handle scheduling a slot on 2027-06-22? That gives Praxis time to confirm API contract on 6/20.
- Support rota: Redwood will provide L2 on-call for cutover week; we need Praxis escalation points for night/weekend. Emma — can you share primary on-call phone/email for Ops?

I've annotated the attached MAP with implementation-level acceptance criteria and flagged three high-risk items (KMS provisioning, schema mismatch on event payload, and rate-limit throttle settings). I attached a short remediation checklist in the doc.

Emma — thanks for the fast turnaround and confirm on the call time. I've updated the MAP with the owners Emma mentioned and pushed a revised file to Drive (link below). A few updates in this version:
- Staging validation moved to 2027-06-27 per your ask (Praxis agreed)
- Load testing tentative window: 2027-06-22 02:00-06:00 PT (Sooj, please confirm)
- KMS owner: Matt Garcia (Praxis) — action: Matt to share KMS key thumbprint and any rotation policy by 2027-06-04
- HubSpot: created playbook and linked tasks to account DL-4821 (https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4821)

I also included a short runbook template for cutover (in Drive). For compliance question: Redwood will provide audit logs at the request level (request id, model id, timestamp, token count, region, redaction metadata) and retains them for 90 days by default; we can extend retention on the Dedicated plan — Marissa and Security can follow up if Praxis needs a SOC2 artifact.

Proposed immediate actions (for clarity):
1) Emma / Matt: mark Praxis owners in column D of the Drive MAP and confirm KMS thumbprint by 2027-06-04.
2) Marissa: share the prompt set and acceptance criteria doc by 2027-06-04.
3) Soojin: confirm load-testing slot or propose alternate within 24 hours.

I'll drop the calendar invite for Thu 2027-06-03 10:00 PT and attach the Drive links.

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
